Info

Factory service constructing FlowPacingBundle instances.

class scarajectory.infrastructure.pacing.flow_pacing_bundle_factory.FlowPacingBundleFactory[source]¶

Bases: object

Factory providing creation of FlowPacingBundle instances.

It defines:

attributes:
DEFAULT_QUEUE_CAPACITY - Default capacity of microcontroller ring buffer.
methods:
create - Constructs FlowPacingBundle with configured collaborators and capacity.
get_version - Returns factory version string.
DEFAULT_QUEUE_CAPACITY: ClassVar[int] = 16¶
classmethod create(*, barrier: IFlowBarrier, capacity: int = 16) → FlowPacingBundle[source]¶

Constructs FlowPacingBundle with injected barrier and capacity.

Parameters:

  • barrier – IFlowBarrier instance managing synchronization barriers.

  • capacity – Microcontroller ring buffer capacity (default 16).

Returns:

FlowPacingBundle instance.

None.
